address: 14 rue de la Mittrie, Dinan, 22100, France
bio: In the heart of medieval Dinan, this modern bistro sports wood furnishings, oak parquet flooring, a fireplace and a view of the kitchen from the small dining room. Vibrant, often surf ‘n turf recipes set the culinary scene: scallops, pig’s ears and lemon confit; sweetbread in an anchovy and Iranian dried lime butter; bream in cardamon and yellow turnips…...
